form.$description: Form — the layout and behaviour around a set of Fields (Storybook's Form, Default + With Validation). Fields stack in one column; a long form splits into titled sections; the actions sit under the last field, Primary first. Validation runs on Submit — nothing is red before the first attempt — and after that each field re-checks as it is corrected; Submit with errors moves focus to the first invalid field. One column capped at maxWidth: a form stretched to the full page width makes every field a long line to scan. Added 2026-10-26.

maxWidth.$description: 480px, the same width as Dialog sm — a form in a page and a form in a small dialog are the same column.

fieldGap.$description: 24px between fields — clearly more than a field's own 4px messages, so a description never reads as belonging to the next field.

sectionTitleGap.$description: 16px title → first field. Padding on the <legend>, since a legend sits outside the fieldset's flex gap.

actionsGap.$description: 12px between the buttons — Dialog's footer gap.
